thread:
erin: FYI rolling v2 header-trim optimization now at 15% canary (10:45PT). Noticed 422s from legacy mobile SDKs on tenant mobile-qa. deploybot pushed the rollout.

deploybot: [deploy] canary roll: v2/header-trim -> canary=15% (2026-03-21T17:45:00Z). Pause: `/deploy pause 6319998888`

james: Confirmed on mobile-qa. Old SDK 0.9.7 sends headers with trailing spaces; v1 tolerated them, v2 trims and rejects. 422 "invalid header"

maria: Repro locally with emulator. We fixed trimming for correctness but didn't add a permissive parse mode. SDKs will need update but patch may take hours.

rory: Ops rec: short-term pin affected tenants (mobile-qa, mobile-prod-canary) to v1. Longer-term: add permissive header parse to v2 and include config flag.

carla: Can we pin just mobile-prod-canary and keep rollout on for the rest? Want to avoid broad rollback.

devops_sam: Applied pins: mobile-prod-canary -> v1, mobile-qa -> v1. :white_check_mark: Current pin list: [mobile-prod-canary, mobile-qa]

erin: Great. Two approaches: (A) revert v2 header change and resume, (B) ship small v2 opt-in permissive parse and resume canary. Which is fastest?

maria: PR #912 adds `--permissive-header-parsing` to v2 and a compatibility test. Build + smoke ETA ~50m. Tests against SDK 0.9.7 pass in CI with flag on.

james: Prefer (B). Avoid full revert. Also publish a quick note to SDK teams and add a line in release notes about header parsing behavior.

carla: I'll reduce canary quota to 5% and set auto-pause tenant threshold to 2 while we unpin & patch.

devops_sam: Threshold set. deploybot will pause on >=2 tenant errors.

deploybot: [action] canary paused at 2026-03-21T17:52:15Z via manual pause by erin. reason: "tenant header-422" (mobile-qa)

rory: I'll add an entry to runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/header-compat with post-fix steps and unpin checklist.

erin: Ops-eyes, add short-term alert for 422 spikes on `api.requests.422.headerparse` for 2h after resume.

ops-eyes: Alert created; paging to eng-oncall for >5 spikes/min for 10m window.

maria: Publishing release note draft and tagging SDK owners. Note: "v2 now trims header whitespace by default; a permissive flag will be available to maintain compatibility with older SDKs. Update SDKs when convenient."

james: Post-fix plan: unpin tenants, resume at 5% for 30m, then 25% if no alerts, document in rollout thread.

erin: Thanks everyone. I'll merge PR once build lands and follow up here before unpin. Closing when live and all pins removed. :thumbsup:
